display_title: The Villainess Is a Millionaire Fixer

titles_en.title: The Villainess Is a Millionaire Fixer
The Villainess is a Millionaire Solver
The Villainess Is a Millionaire Who Solves Everything

description:
I’ve possessed the body of “Aristina Bianca Rosen,” the only daughter of the empire’s wealthiest tycoon and a woman of dazzling beauty. Just when I thought I’d be walking on a bed of roses… Of all times, I’ve been attacked by an unknown assailant right after being branded the empire’s worst villainess?! I narrowly escaped with my life, but the culprit is still out to get me. Thanks to my infamous past, there are suspects lurking everywhere… But the most dangerous of all are the three men circling around me. 

The Crown Prince, who’s kind on the surface but as cold as ice on the inside, the Second Prince, who growls and bickers with me every time we meet, and even the head of the Sacred Order, who’s far too prickly and secretive to be called a saint! I tried to run as far away as possible… so why are they all so obsessed with me?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
